name: TisaLabs Predictive Security
author: Tisalabs

sections.description:
The TisaLabs Predictive Security plugin offers seamless integration with Predictive, streamlining task management and reporting. Effortlessly verify your API key, establish a secure connection with Predictive, execute scans, and access detailed reports—all from the convenience of your WordPress dashboard.

Privacy

This plugin does not track users or collect usage data without explicit consent.

Features

  • Add your API key and get verified to connect with Predictive.
  • Run detailed scans using Predictive’s advanced tools.
  • Download comprehensive reports directly from the dashboard.
  • Simplify task and report management with Predictive integration.

External Service Disclosure

This plugin integrates with the Predictive application (https://app.predictive.ie) to provide real-time threat monitoring and vulnerability assessments.
The Predictive service is operated by TisaLabs and accessed through https://app.predictive.ie.

When you enter and verify your API key, the plugin communicates with Predictive’s servers to perform audits and retrieve reports.

Data Sent
– API key (for authentication)
– Predictive site ID (to identify your site within Predictive’s system)
– Audit ID (when retrieving results for a specific audit)
– Audit requests and configuration parameters (when you initiate an audit)

Data Received
– Security audit results
– Reports and vulnerability assessments tied to the audit ID

When Data Is Sent
Data is only sent when the site administrator adds an API key, initiates an audit, or requests a report.

Why Data Is Sent
This information is required to authenticate your account with Predictive, associate audits with your site, and deliver accurate threat monitoring and vulnerability reports.

Privacy & Terms:
– Predictive Terms of Service: https://www.tisalabs.com/end_user_agreement/
– Predictive Privacy Policy: https://www.tisalabs.com/privacy-policy/

No additional user tracking or analytics are performed by this plugin.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard.
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  4. Click “Upload Plugin” and select the ZIP file.
  5. Click “Install Now” and activate the plugin after installation.
sections.faq:
How do I add my API key?

After activating the plugin, navigate to “Configuration” and enter your API key.

How do I run a scan?

Go to “Audit” in the dashboard, and click “Start Scan.”

Where can I download reports?

Once a scan is complete, the reports will be available for download in the “Reports” section.
